title: Implement Stack Using Queues
description:
Implement a last-in-first-out (LIFO) stack using only two queues. Support push(x), pop(), top(), and empty().

Allowed queue operations: add at the back, inspect or remove the front, read the size, and check whether it is empty. A list or deque may simulate a queue, but may only be used through these operations.

Constraints: values are integers from 1 to 9, with at most 100 method calls. Calls to pop() and top() always have an element available.

Follow-up: implement the same stack with just one queue. Both the two-queue solution and the one-queue follow-up are shown below.
